note: Fixed requests for comparing image runs. A case is a request, not a result: each run needs its own approval, and nothing in this file calls the API. A generate case is planned with plan --case ID. An edit case also needs a parent run: plan --case ID --from RUN_ID, and its edit text is taken from the case. Ratings are a person's judgment on the listed criteria; the deterministic checks cover format, dimensions and aspect ratio only.

cases.title: Simple scene, square ratio
cases.prompt: A red ceramic teapot on a round wooden table, a single lemon beside it, soft morning light from the left, plain pale grey wall behind.

cases.title: Quoted text on a sign, legibility
cases.prompt: A shop front at dusk with a black sign above the door that reads "OPEN LATE" in white capital letters, warm window light, wet pavement reflecting the sign.

cases.title: Product shot with restrictions
cases.prompt: A matte white ceramic mug alone on a dark slate surface, one soft key light from above right. Plain surface, no logo, no lettering, no people, no other objects in the frame.

cases.title: Lite model, its only size
cases.prompt: Three green glass bottles in a row on a white shelf, daylight from a window on the left, simple background.

cases.title: Counted objects with high thinking
cases.prompt: A wooden shelf with exactly three blue books and one red mug, the mug at the right end, evenly lit studio photograph.

cases.title: Keep the subject of a reference image
cases.prompt: Place the subject of the attached reference image in a park at sunset, standing on a grass path. Keep the same face, hair, clothing and pose as in the reference image.

cases.title: Targeted colour change, rest preserved
cases.edit: change the colour of the mug to green

cases.title: Change one line of text, rest preserved
cases.edit: change the sign text to "CLOSED" and keep the same letter style
